verdict: Qwen3-4B, registered run 2: 0.825 [0.789, 0.860] sampled over all 200 held-out days, 0.824 with greedy decoding. Its primary bar, beating the greedy rule's 0.764 [0.726, 0.800] with the 95% intervals apart, is not met: they overlap by 0.011; its secondary, the paired gap +0.061 [+0.013, +0.110] above 0, is met: the first registered training claim on GridSimEnv that holds. Run 1 scored 0.804 and missed both bars; run 2 is +0.021 [-0.015, +0.057] above it, not significant. The warm start did the work: SFT-10k alone scores 0.841 [0.802, 0.877], and GRPO on top did not help: -0.015 [-0.061, +0.030] sampled, -0.046 [-0.090, -0.003] with greedy decoding. A pre-registered confirmatory test then put SFT-10k on 500 fresh eval_iid days: 0.880 [0.858, 0.900] against the greedy rule's 0.751 [0.724, 0.777], paired +0.128 [+0.096, +0.161]: both bars hold, the first pre-registered claim that a trained small model beats the greedy rule outright; on 250 post-RTC+B days only the paired test holds: +0.062 [+0.009, +0.113].
